shell.update.title: Update
shell.update.failed: Could not check. Try again later.
shell.update.installNote: Update downloads the new version, checks that it really comes from us and installs it over this one. Your settings are kept and the program starts again. Nothing is downloaded until you choose.
shell.update.installFailed: The update could not be installed from here. Get the new version from the download page and install it over this one; your settings are kept.
shell.update.automatic: Check for updates and news when the program starts
shell.update.automaticNote: Reads two small files from syntelab.com. Nothing about you or your computer is sent.
shell.help.feedbackHint: Tell us what you need: ask for a new app, a new feature or a change, or report a problem you ran into. Every message is read. The feedback page opens in your browser; nothing is sent from the program itself.
shell.donate.hint: Like what you see? Help us build and keep improving this free software. Your support grows the whole Syntelab Creative ecosystem, for you as well.
shell.start.resetHint: Show all the apps as cards again, in their original order.
shell.layout.globalNote: The layout of every app. An app can have a layout of its own, chosen in its part of Settings.
shell.layout.overrides: This app has a layout of its own. It overrides the general layout and applies to this app only.
shell.layout.followsGlobal: This app follows the general layout. Choosing one here overrides it, for this app only.
shell.ribbon.mode.fullHint: Large buttons with their names, in named groups.
shell.ribbon.mode.compactHint: Icons only; the name of a command shows when the pointer rests on it.
shell.ribbon.mode.hoverHint: Only the tabs are kept. The commands of a tab open over the page while the pointer is on its name.
shell.tabs.startAlways: Keep the Start tab among the tabs
shell.tabs.startAlwaysNote: Off: the Start tab shows only while Start itself is in front. With an app open, the house at the top of the bar on the side brings it back.
shell.tabs.mark: On the tabs of an app
shell.explorerMenu.title: Windows Explorer
shell.explorerMenu.show: Show Syntelab Creative in the right-click menu of files and folders
shell.explorerMenu.note: Adds these entries for your user alone, without administrator rights: {entries}. On Windows 11 they are under “Show more options”. Turn this off before removing the program.
shell.explorerMenu.development: This is a development build: it does not add the entries, since they would start it. Turn this on in the installed program.
shell.explorerMenu.failed: The menu could not be changed.
shell.explorerMenu.incomplete: The apps have gained entries since these were added: {entries}.
shell.help.openHint: The manual of the program and of its apps, in a tab of its own to read beside your work: a table of contents, a search, and every command of this tab with what it does. It is part of the program: nothing is fetched.
shell.help.title: Help
shell.help.nothingFound: Nothing found. Try fewer or other words.
shell.help.commands: Commands of the tab you came from
shell.help.commandsNote: Every command of this menu, as the tab Help was opened from has it, with its keys and what it does.
shell.help.choose: Choose a topic on the left.
shell.tooltips.show: What a button does, said when the pointer is on it
shell.shortcuts.note: These keys work in every app. Click the keys of a command, then press the new ones; Escape leaves them as they are, Backspace takes them away. The keys of an app’s own commands are in its part of Settings.
shell.help.aboutHint: What the program and each app are, which version this is, what they are built with, what they cannot do yet, what is being worked on and how you can help.
shell.tooltips.instantNote: A tooltip shows as soon as the pointer is on a control. Everywhere in the program.
shell.tooltips.delayedNote: A tooltip shows after the pointer has rested on a control for 2 seconds. Everywhere in the program.
shell.tooltips.offNote: No tooltips anywhere in the program. What a command does can still be read in Help, under the commands of a tab.
